newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's China Steel rises on price hike.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's China Steel rises on price hike.

text.p: Shares in Taiwan's largest steelmaker, China Steel Corp, rose in early Thursday trade as its announcement on Wednesday of price increases fuelled buying interest, brokers said.
After 55 minutes of trade, or 0155 GMT, China Steel was the most actively traded issue, jumping 1.66 percent to T$30.6.
"China Steel's price adjustments are higher than originally expected, raising hopes for higher profits this year," said Oliver Fang, an analyst at National Securities.
The firm said late on Wednesday it was raising its third-quarter product prices by T$400 to T$600 per tonne, or about 3.4 to 3.6 percent.
